Bill.BriefDescription: Restricting the interest rates of credit cards.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to the interest rates of credit cards; adding a newchapter to Title 19 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) For the purposes of this section: (a) "Credit card" means a card, plate, booklet, credit card number,credit card account number, or other identifying symbol, instrument, ordevice that can be used to pay for, or to obtain, credit, goods, orservices. (b) "Financial institution" has the same meaning as defined underRCW 30.22.041. (2) A financial institution that issues a credit card may notcharge an interest rate in connection with the credit card that is inexcess of the maximum rate allowed under RCW 19.52.020.

The legislature finds that the practicescovered by section 1 of this act are matters vitally affecting thepublic interest for the purpose of applying the consumer protectionact, chapter 19.86 RCW. A violation of section 1 of this act is notreasonable in relation to the development and preservation of business p. 1 HB 2195and is an unfair or deceptive act in trade or commerce and an unfairmethod of competition for the purpose of applying the consumerprotection act, chapter 19.86 RCW.
Sections 1 and 2 of this act constitute anew chapter in Title 19 RCW.

If any provision of this act or itsapplication to any person or circumstance is held invalid, theremainder of the act or the application of the provision to otherpersons or circumstances is also invalid.
